onset.Description: Seconds from the first stored EEG sample; derived from the EEGLAB event marker.

duration.Description: Speech-stimulus duration reported in the accompanying paper.

session_timestamp.Description: Timestamp copied from the source event table; timezone was not provided.

left_channel_mp3.Description: Audio filename listed for the left speaker in the source event table.

right_channel_mp3.Description: Audio filename listed for the right speaker in the source event table.

target_speaker.Description: Target speaker to attend to; interpreted from the source column Target f/m.

target_location.Description: Spatial location of the target speaker; interpreted from the source column Target l/r.

source_recording_id.Description: Original EEGLAB filename identifier, including source epoch number when a multi-epoch file was split.
